title: config/taxonomy/domains.yaml (drydocs.domains.v1)
description: Shape only (S6): the domain registry, one row per ontology domain (gate ontology-domain-registry-and-edition-grain sB1-sB3, CFG1). vocabulary_fragment is REQUIRED (sB3). Semantics -- fragment exists on disk, every vocabulary entry's domain is registered and active, the base-owned rule for edition rows, the authority resolves in gate-log.md -- live in drydocs_core/ontology/domain_registry.py and tests/unit/test_domain_registry.py.

updated.description: date or string (YAML parses bare dates)

id.description: the join key every vocabulary entry's domain: carries; never renamed

vocabulary_fragment.description: REQUIRED (sB3): the 4x-local-*.yaml fragment that holds this domain's entries

minted_by.description: producer | company (a BASE) | an edition code (config/taxonomy/editions.yaml)

registered_at.description: date or string (YAML parses bare dates)

authority.description: the gate id (a config/gate-log.md heading) or ADR that ruled it
